versions.changelog: 新增第7章 AI系统测试：LLM功能测试、Prompt安全测试、RAG系统测试、AI Agent测试、模型评估基准、最佳实践

- Initial release of "全栈测试工程师" skill for end-to-end test engineering.
- Covers the full testing lifecycle: requirements analysis, test case design, automation scripting, API/interface testing, defect tracking, and report generation.
- Supports leading frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Pytest, Jest, Appium, Locust, etc.) and formats (REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, HTML, Excel, Allure).
- Provides structured methodologies and templates for test strategies, case writing, prioritization, and review.
- Suitable for all scenarios mentioning testing, automation, API, bug analysis, and related quality engineering needs.
